inj.note: Tyson missed the first seven games of the campaign due to a hamstring issue, but he increased his sway in the Saints offense from Week 9 to 10, upping his snap share (24 to 71 percent) and target count (five to 13). In this past Sunday's loss to the Panthers, he recorded an 11-80-0 line, but he emerged from that contest with a new health concern. As a result, Tyson's status will be monitored in advance of Sunday's contest at Chicago.

news.h: Jordyn Tyson's Saints debut showed promise, rookie mistakes
news.d: New Orleans expects to give its first-round rookie "plenty of opportunities" as the season progresses.

news.h: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson, LT Kelvin Banks, cut RB Kendre Miller
news.d: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. have been activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
news.d: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
